Contract ManageCashDeskCRUDService::createCashDesk(id: Integer,name: String,isopened: Boolean): Boolean {
	definition:
		matchedCashDesks: Set(CashDesk) = CashDesk.allInstance()->select(o|o.Id = id),
		targetCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		isopened.oclIsTypeOf(Boolean)
	postcondition:
		if matchedCashDesks.isEmpty() = true 
		then let newCashDesk: CashDesk in
		newCashDesk.oclIsNew() and
		CashDesk.allInstance()->includes(newCashDesk) and
		newCashDesk.Id = id and
		newCashDesk.Name = name and
		newCashDesk.IsOpened = isopened and
		result = true 
		else CashDesk.allInstance()->includes(targetCashDesk) and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
